versions.changelog:
- Updated category from "Utility" to "Security".
- Expanded description for clarity, emphasizing monitoring of token burn rates and session quotas in real-time.
- Replaced "Quota Management" with "Budget Enforcer" and detailed USD/Token consumption limits.
- Added an "Alert System" feature for high-priority notifications before hitting quotas.
- Revised "Architect's Note" to highlight the importance of efficiency in 2026.

Initial release of Agent Token Sentinel — a real-time AI agent cost and quota protection tool.

- Monitors API usage and stops recursive loops or excessive reasoning.
- Enforces session token caps to control costs.
- Tracks and reports real-time profit and loss analytics.
- Simple usage with standardized command-line interface.
